result:
Research complete. Findings below.

---

**Inventory** — root `C:\Users\zht\Documents\Qoder\2026-11-01\4194ac07\webcraft26`; paths below are relative to it.

## 1. Rendering
- Chunk meshing **PARTIAL** — `buildChunkMesh` remeshes the *entire* column Y −64…320 per chunk, no 16³ sections (`src/mesher.ts:248-279`, `src/world.ts:8-10`). One solid + one translucent VBO pair per chunk (`src/mesher.ts:18-20`).
- Texture array **FULL** — 159 layers, mipmaps, premultiplied alpha, animated frames (`src/assets.ts:35-67`, `public/mc/manifest.json`). Animation `interpolate` flag is parsed into the manifest but never used (`src/renderer.ts:1179-1199`).
- Block models **PARTIAL/STUB** — multi-element (non-cube) models bake correctly, cross-plants and torches work (`scripts/build-assets.mjs:235-273`). **`blockstates/*.json` multipart is explicitly rejected**: `throw new Error('multipart blockstates are not supported yet')` (`scripts/build-assets.mjs:277`). Exactly one variant per block, chosen by a hardcoded `DEFAULT_STATE` map: stairs only `facing=east,half=bottom,shape=straight`, slabs only `type=bottom`, logs only `axis=y`, snow `layers=1`, water `level=0` (`scripts/build-assets.mjs:52-63,137-142`). No 6-axis pillars, no top-slabs. Model `force_translucent` (`tr`) is baked into the manifest then dropped (`src/types.ts:34` vs `src/blocks.ts:57-64`).
- Registry is a **fixed baked list of 85 blocks** (`public/mc/manifest.json` `blocks:85`, `scripts/build-assets.mjs:14-102`).
- Biome tint **FULL** — real `grass.png`/`foliage.png` colormaps sampled by per-biome temp/humidity (`src/world.ts:148-158`, `src/assets.ts:118-133`).
- Smooth lighting + AO **PARTIAL** — 4-corner vertex AO with vanilla-ish curve, water light lifted to surface (`src/mesher.ts:102-154`); `noAO` honored for plants (`src/blocks.ts:90`).
- Shadows **PARTIAL** — single cascade, eye-following, radius 86, 512-4096 by quality, 3×3 PCF, alpha-tested (`src/renderer.ts:535-582`). Only the *solid* mesh is rendered into the shadow map: water, glass and all mobs cast nothing (`src/renderer.ts:569-576`).
- Post-FX **PARTIAL** — bloom (half-res, 2 separable taps), 12-tap radial god rays (Ultra only), exposure/saturation/**hand-written contrast curve, not a real filmic tonemap**, vignette, underwater tint (`src/postfx.ts:40-83,167-211`). No MSAA in the post path (`antialias:true` at `src/main.ts:29` is bypassed when post is on), no SSAO/TAA.
- Water **PARTIAL** — dedicated fluid mesher, 8/9 surface height, fresnel + sky reflection + sun specular (`src/mesher.ts:196-246`, `src/renderer.ts:118-139`). **No fluid flow ever**: only `level=0` source blocks exist, no spread, no `level` heights. Lava **PARTIAL** — fullbright emissive path (`src/mesher.ts:200-209`).
- Item models **ABSENT** (blocks only). Entity models **PARTIAL** — 4 hand-typed cuboid part lists (`src/mobRenderer.ts:67-104`).
- Particles **PARTIAL** — block-break chips only (`src/particles.ts:92-120`); `hitBlock` (`src/particles.ts:123`) has **zero callers**. No rain/snow/enchantment portals.
- Sky/sun/moon/stars **PARTIAL** — procedural gradient + hashed stars, not vanilla textures (`src/renderer.ts:155-190`). Moon is hardcoded `full_moon.png`; phase directory unused (`src/assets.ts:105` vs `manifest.environment.moon`). Clouds: one flat plane at y 192.33 (`src/renderer.ts:1126`).
- **Weather ABSENT** — `rain.png`/`snow.png`/`vignette.png` are loaded into `assets.env` (`src/assets.ts:103-115`) and referenced nowhere in `src/renderer.ts` or `src/main.ts`.

## 2. World
- **Fixed 13×13 chunks**, no streaming, no dynamic load/unload: `REGION_RADIUS = 6` (`src/world.ts:12`), `chunkAt` returns null outside (`src/world.ts:192-196`), all 169 generated eagerly at boot (`src/world.ts:380-400`, `src/main.ts:61`). Player is clamped to the box (`src/player.ts:309-325`).
- Features implemented: lakeshore terrain, biome assignment, trees (oak/birch/spruce-conical), cacti, boulders, grass/fern/flower clusters, snow/ice (`src/world.ts:402-750`).
- Biomes **PARTIAL** — 12 names in `BIOME` (`src/world.ts:18-36`); all overworld-ish, no Nether/The End, no rivers/jungles/dark forest.
- Ores **PARTIAL** — coal/iron/copper/diamond only, one fixed band, per-block hash probability (`src/world.ts:495-501`). `gold_ore` and `emerald_ore` are baked and creative-placeable but **never generated** (registered `src/world.ts:164`, absent from gen).
- Structures **PARTIAL/hand-built** — village (house/workshop/well/watchtower), portal, campsite, ruin walls, desert ruin (`src/structures.ts:350-360,631,661,686,717`). All procedural box-and-cylinder builders, **not vanilla NBT schematics**; village placement is hardcoded offsets from one site (`src/structures.ts:354-360`).
- Block updates / tick **ABSENT** — `World` has no `tick`, no random tick, no scheduled blocks, no leaf decay, no sand/gravity, no neighbor updates; `setBlock` is a bare array write (`src/world.ts:225-230`; file ends at `src/world.ts:1435`). Only light is recomputed on edit (`src/world.ts:876`).
- Entity ticking outside view **PARTIAL** — mobs tick unconditionally within a 64-block despawn radius (`src/mobs.ts:111-118`); no view-distance bucketing.

## 3. Player & mechanics
- Game modes **ABSENT** — `StartOptions.mode` is the literal `'survival'` and no code reads it (`src/menu.ts:12,572,945`; `src/main.ts:326-337` ignores `opts.mode`). Actual behavior is creative-only: infinite blocks, instant break, no damage source besides mobs.
- Block breaking **STUB** for vanilla rules — `breakBlock()` deletes immediately (`src/player.ts:361-368`). `hardness` exists in the type (`src/types.ts:54`) and is set in the builder (`scripts/build-assets.mjs:82-86,116`) but is **referenced nowhere in `src/`** — grep confirms one hit. No tool tiers, no mining progress, no break time, no unbreakable check (bedrock is breakable).
- Drops / item pickup **ABSENT** — no item entity, destroyed block vanishes (`src/player.ts:366`).
- Placing **PARTIAL** — sets `def.id` at the adjacent face with no orientation, no facing/axis inference, no block-intersection test beyond the player AABB (`src/player.ts:370-389`). Combined with one-variant baking, stairs/slabs/pillars can only ever be placed in the single baked state.
- Picking **PARTIAL** — reuses/overwrites a hotbar slot; no inventory insertion (`src/player.ts:391-400`).
- Reach **PARTIAL** — hardcoded 5.5 (`src/player.ts:339`); no `block_interaction_range` game rule.
- Inventory model **ABSENT** as a model — the hotbar is a `BlockDef[9]` array of *block types*: no counts, no stack sizes, no durability, no NBT (`src/player.ts:49`, `src/blocks.ts:48` = a hardcoded 9-name list). Picking an item from the creative grid stores only an id (`src/hud.ts:243`).
- Crafting / smelting / brewing / enchanting / anvil / trading / containers / redstone / pistons / doors / beds / difficulty / game rules / commands / chat / scoreboard / advancements / loot tables — **all ABSENT**. Grep across `src/` for `craft|smelt|chest|furnace|hopper|redstone|piston|door|bed|command|scoreboard|advancement|loot` returns only texture paths, block names in villages, and unrelated matches.
- Health **PARTIAL** — 20 HP, hurt flash, invuln frames, respawn at `findSpawn` (`src/player.ts:44-92`). **Hunger, air/oxygen, and experience are ABSENT** (no fields; the XP sprites are extracted to `manifest.gui.experienceBar/experienceProgress` at `scripts/build-assets.mjs:552-553` and never loaded by `src/assets.ts:70-89`).
- Mob spawning **PARTIAL** — caps 10 passive / 8 hostile, 48/64 radii, one light test for hostiles (`src/mobs.ts:83-86,106-108,182-186`); no biome/structure/spawner rules, no spawn caps per type, no natural-light decay. 4 mob types only (`src/mobs.ts:22`). Deaths produce nothing: `onMobDeath` (`src/mobs.ts:429`) is never assigned — `src/main.ts:106` sets only `onPlayerDamage`.

## 4. GUI / menu
- Title, options, create-world, multiplayer list, direct-connect, add-server screens all exist and are pixel-drawn from real 26.2 sprites with a working WebGL panorama (`src/menu.ts:483-698,274-340`).
- **Save/load is ABSENT** — "singleplayer" is one hardcoded card, `DEFAULT_WORLD = { name: 'World', seed: '2602c0de' }` (`src/menu.ts:25,568-583`). Create-world collects name+seed and only fires a toast (`src/menu.ts:941-947` → `src/main.ts:334`); the world was already built with the literal seed `0x2602c0de` at `src/main.ts:60`.
- Options **FULL** for what they touch: quality/render-distance/FOV/filtering/shaders/touch/volume, persisted and applied on start (`src/menu.ts:690-698`, `src/main.ts:299-318`).
- HUD **PARTIAL** — hotbar, selection, 10 hearts, crosshair, item-name popup, toasts, F3 (`src/hud.ts:403-443`). F3 prints a hardcoded `Dist 6` regardless of actual distance (`src/hud.ts:513`). No hunger/air/XP/offhand.
- Creative screen **PARTIAL** — official tab sprites, scrollbar, tooltip, carried-item, 9-slot hotbar row (`src/hud.ts:177-361`). Four tabs are **empty arrays**: Redstone, Tools & Utilities, Combat, Food & Drinks, Spawn Eggs (`src/hud.ts:91-104`). "Search Items" is just the full block list — no search field (`src/hud.ts:103`).
- **Survival Inventory is a layout shell** — `tab_inventory.png` + armor/27-slot grid region is hit-tested to `return null` or `{close}`; only the 9 hotbar slots interact (`src/hud.ts:231-235`).
- Pause **PARTIAL** — a `Resume` button is drawn but has no widget/handler; resume happens via any canvas click → pointer lock (`src/hud.ts:442-460`, `src/main.ts:234`).
- Container screens **ABSENT** — `crafting_table.png`, `furnace.png`, `generic_54.png`, `inventory.png`, `tab_item_search.png` are fetched at boot (`src/assets.ts:77-83`) and never drawn (only 5 `assets.gui.*` keys are used in `src/hud.ts`: creativeItems, creativeInventory, creativeScroller, hotbar, hotbarSelection, crosshair, title, button).

## 5. Multiplayer
- Server side **PARTIAL (built, never run)** — a real 1205-line Paper plugin: `hello/join/move/look/block_set/block_break/chat/inv_req/held/chunk_req` (`bridge/paper-plugin/src/main/java/io/webcraft/bridge/BridgeService.java:258-281`), palette+RLE chunk sections (`ChunkCodec.java`), armor-stand avatars (`Avatar.java`), `BlockPlace`/`BlockBreak`/`AsyncPlayerChatEvent` mirroring (`BridgeService.java:1042-1086`), RFC 6455 over JDK sockets (`ws/WsServer.java`), rate limiting, token/Origin checks (`bridge/PROTOCOL.md:11-19`). Compiles and packages (`build/dist/WebCraftBridge-0.1.0.jar`).
- Client side **ABSENT** — grep for `WebSocket` over `src/` returns **zero hits**. "Join Server" only shows a fake progress message for 2.8 s (`src/main.ts:338-341`). No `/bridge` proxy exists in `vite.config.ts`. The bundled list entry `ws://127.0.0.1:8765` (`src/menu.ts:24`) is unreachable by design.
- Not installed on the live server, and chunk→local-ID mapping, blockstate string mapping, avatar interpolation and player lists are unimplemented (`bridge/README.md:16-19,177-185`).

## 6. Audio
- **PARTIAL** — 28 events copied from the official index: `block.{stone,grass,wood,sand,gravel,glass,snow,wool}.{step,break,place}`, `ui.button.click`, `ambient.underwater.enter/exit` (`scripts/build-assets.mjs:317-327`). Weighted random pick, per-sound volume/pitch, ±6 % pitch jitter, lazy fetch + buffer cache (`src/audio.ts:72-102`).
- **Positional audio ABSENT** — `play()` takes no coordinates, no `PannerNode`, so mob and block sounds are flat 2D (`src/audio.ts:72`).
- **Music ABSENT**, **ambient loops ABSENT** (`block.water.ambient` is bundled but never played; grep for `audio.play` shows no caller), no mob/UI sounds beyond click. Single master volume only (`src/audio.ts:17-20`); no separate music/ambient/record sliders.

## 7. Mobile
- **PARTIAL→FULL for the covered set** — left stick with 34 px travel + sprint-armed flick, right-half look, jump/sneak/flyUp/flyDown/attack/use/inventory/chat/pause buttons, double-tap-jump flight, tap-to-select hotbar (`src/touch.ts:34-96,106-140`, `src/main.ts:386-448`).
- Safe area via `env(safe-area-inset-*)` (`src/touch.css:8-11`), portrait/landscape and 380 px / 430 px / 360 px breakpoints (`src/touch.css:346-402`), `viewport-fit=cover` (`index.html:5`), haptics (`src/touch.ts:536`).
- Performance profile **PARTIAL** — one-shot device sniff picks `medium` on touch, `low` on software GL (`src/main.ts:44-51`); no continuous adaptation.

## 8. Persistence
- **Two localStorage keys only**: `webcraft.menu.settings` and `webcraft.menu.servers` (`src/menu.ts:22-23,267,956`).
- **World persistence ABSENT** — no serializer exists anywhere in `src/world.ts`; block edits, player position, mob state and time all reset on reload. Time even starts at a fixed `ticks = 1000` (`src/main.ts:130`). No IndexedDB, no OPFS, no file export.

## 9. Performance / robustness
- Frustum culling **PARTIAL** — 6-plane AABB test but with hardcoded `y0=-64, y1=180`, ignoring actual chunk height (`src/renderer.ts:511-533`), plus a distance cutoff (`src/renderer.ts:785-792`). Translucents sorted back-to-front (`src/renderer.ts:817-833`).
- Mesh rebuild cost **HIGH** — one block edit rebuilds a **3×3 neighborhood of full-height chunk meshes** and relights a **41³ box** (`src/main.ts:85-86` → `src/renderer.ts:623-629`, `src/world.ts:876-952`).
- Memory: ~290 KB per chunk (196 KB `Uint16` blocks + 98 KB light, full 384-block column always allocated) × 169 ≈ **49 MB** of typed arrays (`src/world.ts:201-204`); vertices are 17 floats = 68 B (`src/mesher.ts:7`).
- Adaptive quality **ABSENT** — static presets, no FPS-driven scaling (`src/main.ts:121-126`); DPR capped at 1.5 (`src/main.ts:140`).
- **Zero `TODO`/`FIXME`/`XXX` comments in `src/`** — grep returns nothing but the word "placeholder" in text-field code, so gaps are undocumented in-source.
- Render distance slider goes to 16 while the world is 6 chunks wide, so 7+ does nothing but widen fog (`src/menu.ts:691`, `src/world.ts:12`).

## Surprises (look implemented, are not)
1. **Multiplayer menu** — real server list, add-server form, MOTD-style rows, built-in `Local Paper` entry, ping/offline sprites preloaded (`src/menuAssets.ts:27-29`). No `WebSocket` exists in `src/`; Join shows a scripted progress message (`src/main.ts:338-341`). Ping sprites are never drawn (`src/menu.ts:468-553` uses only dirt/logo/button/slider/field).
2. **Create New World** — name and seed fields validate and submit, then do nothing but toast; the world was generated before the menu closed, with a hardcoded seed (`src/main.ts:60`).
3. **Survival Inventory tab** — official panel, armor slots, 27-slot grid, all non-interactive; only the bottom 9 slots respond (`src/hud.ts:231-235`).
4. **Furnace / crafting table / chest GUIs** — three container textures downloaded at boot (`src/assets.ts:81-83`) with no code path that renders or opens them.
5. **Search tab** — an official `tab_item_search.png` is loaded (`src/assets.ts:80`) and never drawn; the "search" category is the plain all-blocks grid (`src/hud.ts:103`).
6. **Weather** — `rain.png`, `snow.png`, `vignette.png` fetched (`src/assets.ts:108-110`) with zero consumers; the README's own "not yet" note on weather is accurate.
7. **XP bar and offhand slots** — sprites extracted into the manifest by the build script (`scripts/build-assets.mjs:550-553`) but not even loaded by the client.
8. **Stairs/slabs/pillars in the hotbar** — they render and place, but each is a *single frozen orientation*; the UI implies a full block while the registry holds one baked variant (`scripts/build-assets.mjs:52-63`).
9. **Block hardness numbers** — present and plausible in `manifest.json` and `BlockFlags`, entirely dead data; every block breaks in one click (`src/player.ts:361-368`).
10. **`particles.hitBlock`** — a complete, correct-looking impact-puff implementation with no caller (`src/particles.ts:123`).
11. **README self-deprecation is wrong in one direction**: it claims "未做…粒子" (no particles), but block-break terrain chips with gravity, collision and lighting **are** implemented and wired (`src/main.ts:83`, `src/particles.ts:92-120`).
12. **Shadows look complete but are terrain-only** — no mob or water casts a shadow (`src/renderer.ts:569-576`).
